assets.name: school-day-v2
assets.prompt: Create one original production UI illustration asset school-day-v2 for an Indonesian school attendance application, not a UI mockup. Flat editorial 2D illustration, crisp organic shapes, refined friendly proportions, minimal ink details; cream #FFF5E3, coral #ED896F, mint #7CD3AA, warm yellow #F2C879 and dark ink #303044. A smiling Indonesian high-school student with short black hair, white school shirt and gray trousers, coral backpack, holding a schoolbook, preparing to go to school. Small abstract mint/coral shapes and a simple sun complement the figure. Warm, sophisticated educational editorial art, readable at small scale. Centered complete figure, balanced landscape 5:4 composition with generous transparent margins, no cropping, no text, letters, logos or watermark, no glossy 3D, no photorealism. Actual transparent background, not a drawn checkerboard. Reference style: warm pastel mobile education editorial illustration.
